lines.label: Recommended nozzle temperature
lines.tooltip: Recommended nozzle temperature range of this filament. 0 means not set

lines.label: Chamber temperature
lines.tooltip: Target chamber temperature, and the minimal chamber temperature at which printing should start

lines.label: Cool Plate (SuperTack)
lines.tooltip: Bed temperature when the Cool Plate SuperTack is installed. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Cool Plate SuperTack.

lines.label: Cool Plate
lines.tooltip: This is the bed temperature when the Cool Plate is installed. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Cool Plate.

lines.label: Textured Cool Plate
lines.tooltip: This is the bed temperature when the Textured Cool Plate is installed. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Textured Cool Plate.

lines.label: Engineering Plate
lines.tooltip: This is the bed temperature when the engineering plate is installed. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Engineering Plate.

lines.label: Smooth PEI Plate / High Temp Plate
lines.tooltip: This is the bed temperature when the Smooth PEI Plate/High Temperature Plate is installed. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Smooth PEI Plate/High Temp Plate.

lines.label: Textured PEI Plate
lines.tooltip: This is the bed temperature when the Textured PEI Plate is installed. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Textured PEI Plate.

lines.label: Min fan speed threshold
lines.tooltip: The part cooling fan will run at the minimum fan speed when the estimated layer time is longer than the threshold value. When the layer time is shorter than the threshold, the fan speed will be interpolated between the minimum and maximum fan speed according to layer printing time.

lines.label: Max fan speed threshold
lines.tooltip: The part cooling fan will run at maximum speed when the estimated layer time is shorter than the threshold value.
